    # Find the coordinates of candlelights to the right of the television

    # Get the confidence scores for the detected candlelights
    right_candle_confidences = [cord[1] for cord in right_candle_coordinates]

    # Return the number of candlelights to the right of the television
    return len(right_candle_coordinates)
